item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena watches rain water collect in the pond near her school in Jaipur. Her teacher asks the class to put the stages of the water cycle in the correct order, starting from the Sun heating the water. Which sequence is correct?

options.A: Evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour → condensation into clouds → precipitation → seepage and return flow to water bodies
options.B: Condensation into clouds → evaporation and transpiration → precipitation → rising and cooling of water vapour → seepage and return flow to water bodies
options.C: Precipitation → condensation into clouds → seepage and return flow → evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour
options.D: Rising and cooling of water vapour → precipitation → evaporation and transpiration → condensation into clouds → seepage and return flow to water bodies
